title: Sudden Stop
style: Sub-bass-heavy industrial drone with a very slow sea-shanty pulse, around 44 BPM; metallic percussion in sparse, deliberate strikes, dark sustained low tones, and deep bass-baritone wordless humming and long open-vowel tones. Begin restrained and spacious, gradually thicken the sub-bass and percussion to a tense peak, then stop suddenly with no fade or resolution. Close, resonant vocal texture, raw cinematic production, minimal arrangement.
